name: Overlay
description: One surface primitive for every layered UI element: popover, modal, drawer, bottom sheet and full-screen overlay.

provenance.tag: Rec (all Overlay values); fullscreen for mobile search and seat map: A · unverified

variants.name: fullscreen
variants.description: Radius 0, no elevation, no scrim. For mobile search and seat map.

props.name: title
props.description: heading-2. Required for modal, drawer, sheet and fullscreen, because it is the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Keeps the title for screen readers only.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Where focus goes on open. Default: the first focusable element, or the title if there is none.

props.name: side
props.description: For drawer and sheet. start / end follow the reading direction.

requirements: popover (non-modal): role depends on content (listbox for a combobox, dialog for the passenger picker). Escape closes. Clicking outside closes. Focus returns to the trigger. No focus trap.

modal, drawer, sheet, fullscreen: role="dialog" + aria-modal="true", named by title (aria-labelledby). On open, focus moves to initialFocus (or the first focusable element). Tab is trapped inside. The rest of the page is inert. Page scroll is locked. Escape and the close button both close. On close, focus returns to the element that opened it.
Every modal type has a visible close button (Button iconOnly="x" label="Close") at the top end corner.
Bottom sheets can be dragged closed, but the close button must still exist (dragging is never the only way).

rtl: side="end" opens from the right in English and from the left in Arabic.
Slide-in transforms (translateX) are not logical: they need a [dir="rtl"] override or must use inset-inline-*.
